translations.web: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
translations.bsb: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
translations.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
translations.asv: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
